title: Backend: Indicator Engine (MA/MACD/KDJ/BOLL)
description: Implement pure-function indicator engine in src/strategy_backtest/indicators.py. Each indicator function takes a DataFrame with OHLCV data and configurable parameters, returns DataFrame with new indicator columns appended. Reference stock_analyzer.py for existing MA/MACD patterns; implement KDJ/BOLL from standard formulas.

criteria: calc_ma(df, periods=[5,20,30]) returns DataFrame with columns ma_5, ma_20, ma_30
calc_macd(df, fast=12, slow=26, signal=9) returns DataFrame with columns macd_dif, macd_dea, macd_hist
calc_kdj(df, n=9, k_period=3, d_period=3) returns DataFrame with columns kdj_k, kdj_d, kdj_j
calc_boll(df, period=20, stddev=2) returns DataFrame with columns boll_upper, boll_middle, boll_lower
calc_indicators(df, config) dispatches to individual calc functions based on indicator config dict
All functions are pure: no side effects, no DB access, input DataFrame not mutated
NaN handling: indicator columns have NaN for insufficient history periods (e.g., first 19 rows of MA20)
Reference stock_analyzer.py MA/MACD patterns for consistency
convergence.definition_of_done: 4 indicator functions produce correct values on known data and handle edge cases

files.change: Create indicator engine with calc_ma, calc_macd, calc_kdj, calc_boll, calc_indicators functions

implementation.title: Study existing MA/MACD patterns
implementation.description: Read src/stock_analyzer.py to understand existing MA and MACD calculation patterns for consistency

implementation.title: Implement calc_ma
implementation.description: Simple moving average using pandas rolling mean. Support configurable periods list.

implementation.title: Implement calc_macd
implementation.description: MACD using pandas ewm. DIF = EMA(fast) - EMA(slow), DEA = EMA(DIF, signal), HIST = DIF - DEA. Match stock_analyzer.py logic.

implementation.title: Implement calc_kdj
implementation.description: KDJ stochastic oscillator. RSV = (Close - LowN) / (HighN - LowN) * 100. K = SMA(RSV, k_period), D = SMA(K, d_period), J = 3*K - 2*D.

implementation.title: Implement calc_boll
implementation.description: Bollinger Bands. Middle = SMA(close, period), Upper = Middle + stddev * STD(close, period), Lower = Middle - stddev * STD(close, period).

implementation.title: Implement calc_indicators dispatcher
implementation.description: Single entry point that takes DataFrame and indicator config dict, calls relevant calc functions, returns enriched DataFrame.

reference.examples: Follow pandas rolling/ewm patterns from stock_analyzer.py

rationale.chosen_approach: Pure functions taking DataFrame, returning enriched DataFrame. Stateless design for testability.
decision_factors: Testability (pure functions are easy to test)
rationale.tradeoffs: Manual implementation of KDJ/BOLL vs TA-Lib, but avoids new dependency and gives full control

unit: test_calc_ma_correctness: verify MA5 values on known price series
test_calc_macd_correctness: verify DIF/DEA/HIST on known data
test_calc_kdj_correctness: verify K/D/J on known data
test_nan_handling: verify NaN in first N-1 rows for MA(N)
test_empty_dataframe: verify graceful handling of empty input
success_metrics: All indicator values within 0.01% of hand-calculated reference
